lines.zh: 雪上只留下我的脚印，很深。
lines.en: Only my prints in the snow, and they sink deep.

lines.zh: 我跳过冰刺，像跨过门槛。
lines.en: I leap the ice spikes like a doorstep.

lines.zh: 别看我的后腿，那是起跳用的。
lines.en: Do not watch my hind legs. They are for launching.

lines.zh: 这片雪原，我跳一遍就够了。
lines.en: One crossing and this snowfield is mine.

lines.zh: 我走路没有声音，落地才有。
lines.en: I walk silent. Only the landing speaks.
The ice is slick. Good landing practice.
A rabbit leaps far, and lands true.
My shadow arrives first. I follow.
Keep off my runway.
This snow is too soft. It swallows my step.
Circling you is not fear.

lines.zh: 三跳之内，我能到你面前。
lines.en: Three hops and I am in your face.

lines.zh: 我磨牙的时候，你最好别出声。
lines.en: When I grind my teeth, stay quiet.
Snow on my ears. Cold.
I stare at the ice, waiting for it to crack.

lines.zh: 血色的眼睛，看什么都是红的。
lines.en: Red eyes. Everything looks red to me.
No other rabbits around here.
I do not eat grass. Too soft.

lines.zh: 耳朵一转，整片林子都听见。
lines.en: One ear turn, and the whole wood is heard.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子在动，不是害怕。
lines.en: My nose twitches. It is not fear.

lines.zh: 冬天很长，我有的是时间。
lines.en: Winter is long. I have time.

lines.zh: 谁在这儿埋了根胡萝卜？
lines.en: Who buried a carrot here?
You look at me. I measure you.
Your eyes will not stay long.
Taller than me, but slower.

lines.zh: 你手里那根木棍，挡不住我。
lines.en: That stick will not stop me.
I see your throat move.
Do not back away. Backing invites a chase.
Red eyes see the living best.
Your shadow is under my feet.
I have your gait memorized.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？很快就不笑了。
lines.en: What are you smiling at? Not for long.
You hit me. Lucky.
A tuft of fur gone. Nothing.
That woke me properly.

lines.zh: 白毛上多了道口子，无妨。
lines.en: A scratch on white fur, that's all.
Pain only makes me sharper.
Hit my ear and you will regret it.
I step back to leap.
This blood is mine, not yours.
Again. I will let you finish.
Snow on your hands. That was light.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜？留着喂乖兔子去。
lines.en: Carrots? Save them for the tame ones.

lines.zh: 你晃那根草，我只觉得可笑。
lines.en: Waving that green thing only amuses me.
I eat nothing you offer.
Food for your life? Dream on.

lines.zh: 那朵蒲公英，我踩过去就行。
lines.en: That dandelion, I will simply step on.
Your hand is far too close.
I am not hungry. I just want to move.
Sweet things make you careless.
You think a rabbit must eat greens.
Put it away. I follow no one.
Bump me? I am harder than I look.

lines.zh: 别踩我的后腿，我正要起跳。
lines.en: Don't step on my hind leg; I'm about to leap.
One kick of my hind legs and you fall.
Do not push me toward the ice spikes.
You smell of blood.

lines.zh: 退开两步，我才能看清你。
lines.en: Two steps back, so I can see you whole.
You ruffled my fur.
A collision is the opening.
I do not mind being squeezed. I mind being bored.
Come one step closer. Try.
There is no second one like me.
Rabbits flock. I walk alone.
A mate? I look for opponents.

lines.zh: 雪原这么大，没有人配得上。
lines.en: The snowfield is vast. No one is worthy.

lines.zh: 我不繁殖，我只守着这片白。
lines.en: I do not breed. I keep this white.
Do not worry for me. I am not lonely.
Spring will change nothing.

lines.zh: 两只红眼睛，会互相提防。
lines.en: Two red eyes would only watch each other.
My companion is this snow.
Leave. Do not ask such things.
This hide, I keep to wipe my claws.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜我捡起来，再踩碎。
lines.en: I pick the carrot up, then crush it.
A feather on the ground. Mine.

lines.zh: 谁掉的兔脚？我不靠运气。
lines.en: A dropped rabbit's foot? I need no luck.
I carry a stone and hurl it far.

lines.zh: 这东西不重，我一跳就带着。
lines.en: Not heavy. I carry it in one hop.
I picked up your arrow. Returning it.

lines.zh: 雪下面的东西，都被我挖出来。
lines.en: Whatever lies under the snow, I dig out.
Not gold. Too bright.

lines.zh: 捡完就扔，我只是想拿一下。
lines.en: I will drop it after. I just wanted to hold it.
You have stepped onto my snowfield.

lines.zh: 耳朵听见你的心跳，很快。
lines.en: My ears catch your heartbeat. Fast.
The red eyes have lit.

lines.zh: 你跑不掉，雪会留下脚印。
lines.en: You cannot escape. Snow keeps footprints.

lines.zh: 我起跳之前，从不打招呼。
lines.en: I never announce a leap.
Three steps away. Perfect.

lines.zh: 今天总算有东西可以追了。
lines.en: Today there is finally something to chase.
Your boots are too loud.

lines.zh: 我看见你手里的火把在抖。
lines.en: I see your torch trembling.

lines.zh: 别找掩体，雪原没有掩体。
lines.en: Do not look for cover. The snowfield has none.
You are already mine.
One leap will do it.

lines.zh: 风把气味送到我鼻子里。
lines.en: The wind brings your scent to my nose.
When I laugh, you had better run.

lines.zh: 白毛在雪里，你差点没看见我。
lines.en: White fur in white snow — you almost missed me.

lines.zh: 你的影子压到我的洞口了。
lines.en: Your shadow is falling across my burrow.
I flatten low. Hind legs coil.
You go left, I am there first.
Do not look back. Looking back slows you.

lines.zh: 我一跳一跳地缩短距离。
lines.en: Hop by hop, the gap closes.
Your breathing is falling apart.

lines.zh: 雪地会告诉我你在哪儿。
lines.en: The snow tells me where you are.
I wait for one mistake.
You raised your arm. That was it.
The ice spikes will slow you for me.
I stay silent. Noise would warn you.
Two more hops and I am there.

lines.zh: 你已经在我的跳跃范围里。
lines.en: You are inside my leap range.

lines.zh: 别等天黑，我夜里也看得见。
lines.en: Do not wait for dark. I see at night.
This one, I have measured.

lines.zh: 我耳朵转过去，锁着你的呼吸声。
lines.en: My ears turn and lock onto your breathing.
The ice is slick; run and you'll fall.

lines.zh: 我数你的步数，第四步我就动。
lines.en: I count your steps — on the fourth, I move.

lines.zh: 别往坡下跑，那里雪更深。
lines.en: Don't run downhill; the snow is deeper there.

lines.zh: 我磨牙的声音，你听见了吧。
lines.en: You hear me grinding my teeth, don't you?

lines.zh: 你转身的时候，我已经起跳了。
lines.en: When you turned, I was already in the air.
This kick could split a wooden shield.
My claws land first. You land after.
Do not cover your face. Useless.

lines.zh: 我跳起来的时候，你抬头了。
lines.en: You looked up as I leapt.
This one is for your legs.

lines.zh: 我落回雪里，雪都飞起来。
lines.en: I land and the snow bursts up.
Your armor is too thin.
Do not shout. The snow eats sound.
One more and I will leave.

lines.zh: 你退了三步，还是没躲开。
lines.en: Three steps back, and you still failed.
My teeth are quicker than my feet.
I like the feel of the impact.

lines.zh: 你倒下的样子，很像雪堆。
lines.en: You fell like a heap of snow.
That one is on me.

lines.zh: 我的前爪按在你胸口上。
lines.en: My forepaws land square on your chest.
The snowpack gets a fresh dent where I hit.

lines.zh: 你倒下去，压塌一堆积雪。
lines.en: You go down and crush a drift of snow.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在护腕上，咬穿了。
lines.en: This bite lands on your bracer and goes through.

lines.zh: 我落地时，你已经滚出去了。
lines.en: By the time I land, you've already rolled away.

lines.zh: 血滴在雪上，红得很显眼。
lines.en: Blood on the snow stands out badly.

lines.zh: 雪原上睁开了一双红眼睛。
lines.en: A pair of red eyes opens on the snowfield.
I push up out of the snow.
No other rabbits. Only me.
This white suits my fur.
Ears first. Feet second.
I smell something alive.
I have a den between the ice spikes.
It is cold. It suits my temper.
Who set a trap here?
I shake my fur and the snow falls off.

lines.zh: 别看我的眼睛，会忘不掉。
lines.en: Do not meet my eyes. You will not forget.
This ground is mine now.
Fire singed my fur. Noted.
Bad landing. It will not happen twice.
A rabbit in water cannot hop.
My ears ring. You are finished.
Arrows? I have picked up plenty.
This strange taste makes me sick.
Hungry rabbits kick harder.
Thunder? Louder than my footsteps.
No snow in the void. I am not going.
